meta.title: Leonardo Rodrigues Boni — full stack developer (Java, Go, .NET)

Hi!

Thanks for reaching out through my portfolio. Your message arrived and I'll get back to you as soon as I can — usually within two days.

Leonardo Rodrigues Boni
